defs.d: Physical frame.
Main section.
To give body or shape to something.
To construct the bodywork of a car.
The act or process by which something is built; construction.
defs.ex: The building of the bridge will be completed in a couple of weeks.

defs.d: A closed structure with walls and a roof.
defs.ex: My sister lives in that apartment building.

defs.d: The price paid for obtaining, or price received for providing, money or goods in a credit transaction, calculated as a fraction of the amount or value of what was borrowed.
defs.ex: Our bank offers borrowers an annual interest of 5%.

defs.d: Any excess over and above an exact equivalent
To engage the attention of; to awaken interest in; to excite emotion or passion in, in behalf of a person or thing.
defs.ex: Action films don't really interest me.

defs.d: To be concerned with or engaged in; to affect; to concern; to excite.
(plural) Those ones.
(singular) Him, her, or it; that one.
A person under discussion; a question of which person.
(interrogative) What person or people; which person or people; asks for the identity of someone. (used in a direct or indirect question)
defs.ex: I don't know who it is. (indirect question)

defs.d: (interrogative) What is one's position; asks whether someone deserves to say or do something.
defs.ex: I don't like what you did, but who am I to criticize you? I've done worse.

defs.d: Suitableness.
The quality or state of being able; capacity to do or of doing something; having the necessary power.
defs.ex: This phone has the ability to have its software upgraded wirelessly.

defs.d: The encountering of risks; a bold undertaking, in which dangers are likely to be encountered, and the issue is staked upon unforeseen events; a daring feat.
A remarkable occurrence; a striking event.
defs.ex: A life full of adventures.

defs.d: A candidate or voter not affiliated with any political party, a freethinker, free of a party platform.
A neutral or uncommitted person.
Not dependent; not contingent or depending on something else; free.
Not affiliated with any political party.
defs.ex: the independent candidate

The part of a violin bow (or that of other similar string instruments such as the viola, cello and contrabass) located at the end held by the player, to which the horsehair is attached.
To hunt or trap frogs.
To use a pronged plater to transfer (cells) to another plate.
(with "the", a demonstrative, or a possessive) Those who have died.

defs.d: (often with "the") Time when coldness, darkness, or stillness is most intense.
defs.ex: The dead of night. The dead of winter.

defs.d: (usually plural) Sterile mining waste, often present as many large rocks stacked inside the workings.
A small amount.

defs.d: Small in size.
defs.ex: This is a little table.

defs.d: Insignificant, trivial.
defs.ex: It's of little importance.

defs.d: Not much.
defs.ex: This is a little known fact.  She spoke little and listened less.

defs.d: Not at all.

A result that is desired; an intention.
The act of removing something.

To move something from one place to another, especially to take away.
defs.ex: He removed the marbles from the bag.

defs.d: To murder.
A man of a higher rank or position.
A respectful term of address to a man of higher rank or position, particularly:
To address (someone) using "sir".
defs.ex:
Sir, yes, sir!
Don't you sir me, private! I work for a living!

A decided case which is cited or used as an example to justify a judgment in a subsequent case.
The head of state of a republic.

defs.d: In presidential republics, the head of government and head of state.
Occupying the first rank or chief place; having the highest authority; presiding.
Under normal conditions or circumstances; usually; most of the time

defs.d: In the expected or customary manner.
To disturb or irritate, especially by continued or repeated acts; to bother with unpleasant deeds.

Troubled, irritated by something unwanted or unliked (an annoyance); vexed.
To strengthen; to make firm or resolute.
To administer the sacrament of confirmation on (someone).
Disdain, contemptuous feelings, hatred.
Action or behaviour displaying such feelings; an outrage, insult.
To vex; to annoy; to offend contemptuously.
In spite of, notwithstanding, regardless of.
To stir together.

defs.d: To combine (items from two or more sources normally kept separate).
defs.ex: Don't mix the meat recipes with the dairy recipes.

defs.d: A review or a revision.
A second proof sheet; a proof sheet taken after the first or a subsequent correction.
To look at again, to reflect on.
To review, alter and amend, especially of written material.
defs.ex: This statute should be revised.

defs.d: To be entitled to, as a result of past actions; to be worthy to have.

defs.d: To earn, win.
An event or occurrence.

defs.d: A (relatively minor) event that is incidental to, or related to others.
Arising as the result of an event, inherent.
(of a stream of particles or radiation) Falling on or striking a surface.

defs.d: A business partnership; the name under which it trades.
A business enterprise, however organized.
